name: plateia
description: Event-driven ticketing platform with micro frontends (Module Federation) and Fastify microservices.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n catalog,booking,payment,notify,office,mfe-catalog,mfe-booking,mfe-admin,shell -c blue,magenta,yellow,red,gray,cyan,green,magentaBright,white "npm run dev -w @plateia/catalog-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/booking-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/payment-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/notification-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/backoffice-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-catalog" "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-booking" "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-admin" "npm run dev -w @plateia/shell"
scripts.dev:services: concurrently -k -n catalog,booking,payment,notify,office -c blue,magenta,yellow,red,gray "npm run dev -w @plateia/catalog-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/booking-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/payment-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/notification-service" "npm run dev -w @plateia/backoffice-service"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n mfe-catalog,mfe-booking,mfe-admin,shell -c cyan,green,magentaBright,white "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-catalog" "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-booking" "npm run dev -w @plateia/mfe-admin" "npm run dev -w @plateia/shell"
